title: What happens at a Materials Recycling Facility? (MRF) - How does our sorting machine work?
summary: A short tour of a UK materials recycling facility showing how mixed recyclables are mechanically and optically sorted. Aluminum, ferrous metal, glass, paper, and trash come out as separate streams.
why: HN links it as a concrete example of the scale and speed of automated recycling sorting.

quote.text: Mixed recycling goes in, and aluminum, ferrous metal, glass cullet sorted by color, paper, and trash come out.
